entities.name: Iris Yassmin Barrios Aguilar

entities.summary: Iris Yassmin Barrios Aguilar is a judge and the president of one of Guatemala's two High Risk Court Tribunals. She was the presiding judge in the case of Efraín Ríos Montt, a former dictator of Guatemala.
